tech_points.description: Used to upgrade DedSec gadgets, weapons, and hacks. Appear as small diamond-shaped icons on the map.

items.name: The British Museum
items.guide: In a tent at the front of the building. Use the entrance with two gates and jump the fence section there to avoid alerting guards.

items.name: ETO Bank Construction Site
items.guide: At the top of the tower overlooking the site. Reach it by cargo drone.

items.name: Argyle Inn
items.guide: On the roof of the smaller building. Fly a cargo drone to the roof, then send a Spiderbot into the ventilation shaft.

items.name: Royal Courts of Justice
items.guide: On the roof of the smaller building, outside any restricted area. A cargo drone gets you there.

items.name: Leather Lane
items.guide: In an evidence room. Enter the garage, send a Spiderbot through the vent, and follow it to the end.

items.name: Albion Station Camden
items.guide: In an evidence room. Climb the drainpipe at the back of the building, incapacitate the guard, and use a Spiderbot through a hole in the wall.

items.name: Furzton Tower Block
items.guide: On a small shelf beside the patio on the first floor. A guard is nearby, so a cargo drone is the safest approach.

items.name: University College London
items.guide: On the roof of a small shed in the courtyard. Fly a cargo drone to the roof, then use a Spiderbot in the ventilation.

items.name: United Souls Search
items.guide: On the roof of the building. Reach it by cargo drone.

items.name: GBB House
items.guide: On the roof of the building, near United Souls Search so you can collect both together.

items.name: Crescent Park
items.guide: On scaffolding next to the fence, with a construction worker nearby. Use a drone or sneak through the main gate.

items.name: Albion Internment Centre
items.guide: In a prison cell. Fly a cargo drone over the fence to the grass patch right of the main entrance, then use a Spiderbot through the ventilation shaft.

items.name: Blume Complex
items.guide: On the roof of the building. Reach it by cargo drone.

items.name: Cruciform Hospital
items.guide: In the courtyard. The gate is locked from inside, so use a cargo drone.

items.name: Carcani Medical
items.guide: In the ventilation shaft beneath the ground-floor laboratories. Open the gate, send in a Spiderbot, and move it through the complex.

items.name: Camden Market
items.guide: At one of the fair booths.

items.name: St. Pancras International
items.guide: In a cell on the terminal floor. Open it using the terminal across the corridor. A Spiderbot is the safest way inside.

items.name: Ministry of Civic Management
items.guide: On a table in the ministry's yard. Use a Spiderbot to get it.

items.name: Camden High Street
items.guide: On a table. Take the lift in the alley next to Camden Town station, then climb the drainpipe.

items.name: Solar Garden
items.guide: On the circular top floor. Fly in with a cargo drone, find a grate, and throw a Spiderbot through it.

items.name: US Embassy
items.guide: In a restricted area on the lower level. Reach it quietly with a Spiderbot, or use a transport drone at the risk of being detected.

items.name: Nine Elms Walkway
items.guide: In a restricted area. Use an Albion employee or builder outfit. On the right side of the bridge, shoot the barrel beside the X-marked wooden door to blow it open, then enter.

items.name: Vauxhall Tower
items.guide: Behind a locked door. Use a transport drone to hook explosives, fly to the roof, and drop them near the terminal.

items.name: Albion Station Nine Elms
items.guide: On the top floor. Call a transport drone, drop explosives on the X-marked wooden door, and enter the room.

items.name: Parcel Fox Distribution Centre
items.guide: In a restricted area. Place a Spiderbot in the air duct and descend; raise the grate while hovering above it.

items.name: The Battersea
items.guide: In a restricted lower level. Use a jet ski to enter, or use a Spiderbot through the grate to unlock the door.

items.name: Nine Elms Docks
items.guide: Heavily guarded. Use a Spiderbot in the ventilation shaft near the point, then jump on the pipes and head to the end of the area.

items.name: Helmsman's Tracks
items.guide: In a restricted area, break two identical plywood walls (marked with a red X), one behind the other.

items.name: Albion Bethnal Green Station
items.guide: Climb the unfinished staircase in the building to reach the room with the Tech Point.

items.name: Cemetery Park
items.guide: In a small building in the park's corner. Use a Spiderbot to get inside.

items.name: Wapping Albion Station
items.guide: On the building's roof. Use a drone to reach it.

items.name: Thames Landing
items.guide: In a room under a landing that can't be entered from either side. Use the Spiderbot located inside.

items.name: Royal London Hospital
items.guide: Where part of the hospital overhangs the street, on a small roof with scaffolding. The Tech Point is inside.

items.name: Albion Drone Factory
items.guide: Inside the building, past a door protected by an alarm (unless you wear an Albion costume). A guard is nearby.

items.name: Whitechapel Terminus
items.guide: On the lower level of the complex. Drop down near the restricted zone border and throw a Spiderbot over the fence.

items.name: Brick Lane
items.guide: On a building's roof. Fly a drone over to collect it.

items.name: Old Spitalfields Market
items.guide: Inside a building at the entrance, reached by stairs. The area is guarded, so you'll need to defeat at least one enemy.

items.name: Tower of London
items.guide: Inside a small cage in the courtyard. The area is guarded, so fly a drone up and drop a Spiderbot in.

items.name: Tower Bridge
items.guide: At the top of the bridge. Enter through a window on one of the towers, climb to the top, step outside above the street, and throw a Spiderbot to the upper floor to retrieve it.

items.name: Stafford Auto Garage
items.guide: On the top floor, on the desk beside the computer. Climb the container to reach the floor with two cars, fight through the guards, then go up the stairs on the far side and turn left.

items.name: Old Canal Warehouse
items.guide: On a box on the warehouse roof. Call a nearby cargo drone and fly up to it instead of fighting the heavy guards.

items.name: Cargo Collective
items.guide: On the floor of a locked room. Fly a cargo drone one floor up to grab the access key, then open the door.

items.name: World of Tomorrow
items.guide: Inside the club, next to the slot machines on the lower floor.

items.name: Hackney Baths
items.guide: On the desk beside the computer in a room with doors on both sides. Eliminate the guards one by one, then go forward and up.

items.name: Fusilli Tower
items.guide: At the top of the public tower. Use the nearest cargo drone and fly as high as it goes.

items.name: Inspire Towers
items.guide: On a metal box on the balcony beside the Inspire tower. Reach it with a cargo drone.

items.name: NeoGate
items.guide: At the far end of a ventilation duct. Take the stairs to the basement, use a Spiderbot through the vent shafts, and follow the duct on the right, below the ceiling.

items.name: Finsbury New Project
items.guide: At the end of a route on the platforms to the right. Throw a Spiderbot through the open grate on the lowest floor, and keep it away from water.

items.name: Battlebridge Basin
items.guide: On the large balcony by a table. Fly a cargo drone to the marked spot, then jump down.

items.name: The Sandstone Residence
items.guide: At the end of an air duct on the left. Get the access key from the garden with a cargo drone, enter the building, go up a floor, and send a Spiderbot through the vent.

items.name: Seam Nightclub
items.guide: On the scaffolding. Fly a cargo drone to the marked spot, then jump down to collect it.

items.name: Vauxhall Bridge
items.guide: Under the bridge, in a room behind a cage. Enter through a hole with a Spiderbot, then destroy the barrel blocking the way.

items.name: Perry Harris Redevelopment
items.guide: On the barrels at the lowest level of the construction site. A Spiderbot can sneak you in.

items.name: Lambeth Bridge
items.guide: In a room below the bridge that is locked from the inside. Use a Spiderbot to get in.

items.name: Wellington Arch
items.guide: On the tower's roof, under the floor. Go through the collapsed floor and into a ventilation shaft with the Spiderbot.

items.name: Buckingham Palace
items.guide: On a table across from the guard room near the main entrance. Distract the patrolling guard.

items.name: Broco Tech
items.guide: In a ventilation shaft beside the main entrance. Use a Spiderbot.

items.name: Westminster Abbey
items.guide: In a pot on the roof of the building next to the courtyard. A cargo drone is needed.

items.name: Downing Street
items.guide: On a table in the central courtyard, next to an alarm camera. A drone can fly in directly.

items.name: Admiralty Arch
items.guide: At the junction between the complex's two buildings. Reach it with a cargo drone.

items.name: London Carriage Service
items.guide: In the underground part of the complex, reached through a small office by the round tower. Disable the alarm gates, subdue the guard, then throw the Spiderbot to the ventilation shaft.

items.name: Canadian High Commission
items.guide: On the roof, under the stairs. Fly in with a cargo drone, then use a Spiderbot.

items.name: Regalia Theatre
items.guide: At the connector between buildings. Use a cargo drone or the lift after lowering the road posts.

items.name: Palace of Westminster
items.guide: On the building's balcony. A drone can reach it.

items.name: Chinatown
items.guide: In a netted storage room in the courtyard of a restricted area. Enter through a hole in the fence with a Spiderbot.

items.name: New Scotland Yard
items.guide: On a table on the floor with the guard room.

items.name: Buckingham Royal Mews
items.guide: Inside the building, in the room next to the garage door.

items.name: SIRS HQ
items.guide: In a locked upstairs storage room. The terminal that unlocks the door is in the next room.

items.name: Covent Garden Piazza
items.guide: Behind a wooden wall with a hole, near the marketplace at the south entrance of a restricted area. Deploy a Spiderbot through the hole.

items.name: Buckingham Palace Gardens
items.guide: On one of the tables on the terrace at the back of the palace.

items.name: Throne's Felts
items.guide: Inside the building, on the lowest level under the stairs. A Spiderbot is the easiest way in.

items.name: Somerset House
items.guide: Under the floor. Take the Spiderbot behind the stage to a broken grate under the stairs and go through it.

items.name: Toan Attack Site
items.guide: Under rubble. You'll need the Spiderbot to reach it.

items.name: The Cheesegrater
items.guide: Near the main entrance, past a damaged fan. Deploy the Spiderbot and follow the corridor inside.

items.name: Carousel Plaza
items.guide: On the top tier of the curved section, beside the antenna. Use a drone.

items.name: Walkie Talkie
items.guide: In a locked room behind an elevator. Unlock a network node using the cameras in the room.

items.name: St. Dunstan-in-the-East
items.guide: In the tower, at a broken window. Use a drone.

items.name: Bank of England
items.guide: Inside a ventilation shaft whose entrance is in a control room. Only the Spiderbot can reach it.

items.name: The Spine
items.guide: Climb the scaffolding and building facade to a small room. Send the Spiderbot through a hole in the wall, then continue along the scaffold.

items.name: Horizon Multinational
items.guide: On the roof. Use a drone.

items.name: Finsbury Circus Gardens
items.guide: Under a small building near the complex entrance.

items.name: Barbican Centre
items.guide: At the bottom of the complex, on a table below the stairs. An Albion employee disguise helps here.

items.name: Old Bailey
items.guide: On a balcony. A cargo drone is the quickest way to reach it.

items.name: Great Fire Monument
items.guide: On a balcony on the building's highest level. Use a drone.

items.name: County Hall
items.guide: On the bottom of a hole with a ladder, above the building. Reach it with the Spiderbot.

items.name: Millennium Wheel
items.guide: In a closed room. Unlock a node by using a cargo drone to move boxes and clear the signal path.

items.name: Southbank Atrium
items.guide: On the lowest level, in a room inside a fenced hall guarded by Clan Kelley.

items.name: British Theatre
items.guide: On the roof. Fly there with the drone.

items.name: Waterloo Plaza
items.guide: On the roof. Fly there with the drone.

items.name: London Lens
items.guide: In the tunnels at the base of the round building. Enter through the tunnel entrance, defeat the guard, climb the scaffolding, and throw the Spiderbot onto the shelf above.

items.name: London Necropolis
items.guide: On the roof of the complex. Reach it with the drone.

items.name: Oasis Church
items.guide: In a roof ventilation shaft. Open the hatch beside it and deploy the Spiderbot. Watch for traps.

items.name: Lambeth Tower
items.guide: On a balcony. A cargo drone is the easiest way up.

items.name: Kennington Albion Station
items.guide: In a locked ground-floor room. Get the digital key from a computer on the first floor.

items.name: Lambeth Palace
items.guide: In a ventilation shaft in the courtyard. Deploy the Spiderbot and follow the vent.

items.name: The Ascent
items.guide: In a café on the roof. Reach it with the drone.

items.name: FLVR Restaurant
items.guide: On the roof, inside a locked cage. Complete the circuit on the clock tower to open it.

items.name: Michael Faraday Memorial
items.guide: On a roof. Find the ventilation hatch and deploy the Spiderbot inside. Protesters may be nearby in the afternoon.

items.name: UK Fibrecomm Centre
items.guide: On a column next to a wall. Fly to the roof with the drone and deploy the Spiderbot to collect it.

items.name: Kennington Park
items.guide: Under a parked car. Move the car to collect it.

items.name: Brixton Recreation Centre
items.guide: At the top of a skyscraper. Reach it by drone, or use the elevator to the lower level and climb the gutter.

items.name: Brixton Barrier Block
items.guide: On the roof. Reach it with the drone.

items.name: Kennington Gas Tank
items.guide: On the roof. The drone is the easiest option.

items.name: Dorrel Hand Car Wash
items.guide: Inside the complex. Break the wooden wall marked with a red X near the main gate, or enter from another side.

items.name: European Processing Centre
items.guide: In a restricted-area room. Use the drone to find the entrance.

items.name: MI6 Building
items.guide: On the roof. Fly up with the drone and deploy the Spiderbot to collect it.

items.name: E-TREE
items.guide: At the bottom of the building, in a ventilation shaft. Reach the roof by drone, enter through an open window with the Spiderbot, and use a second vent to the left to get past the grate.

items.name: Green Estate
items.guide: On the roof, by the table next to the camera.

items.name: Lambeth Town Hall
items.guide: On the roof. Fly there with the drone and check the ventilation shaft near the northern edge.

items.name: St. Thomas' Hospital
items.guide: In a ventilation shaft near the northern edge of the roof. Deploy the Spiderbot and watch for traps. The area is heavily guarded.

items.name: HMS Belfast
items.guide: On the highest deck of the ship. Use a drone to reach it.

items.name: AYW Imports
items.guide: On the building's roof. Drop a Spiderbot or fly a drone.

items.name: Queen's Walk
items.guide: In a vent shaft by the river. Unlock the locked hatch with the circuit using the nearby drones, then enter with a Spiderbot.

items.name: Shad Thames Plaza
items.guide: On the roof. Use a drone.

items.name: Rotherhithe Docks
items.guide: On the roof. A drone is the easiest way up.

items.name: Southwark River Gate
items.guide: On the roof, under the grid. Use a Spiderbot, then jump through the hole on the far side of the roof.

items.name: Tidis
items.guide: Outside the complex, next to the terminal that opens the gates. Use a drone.

items.name: Tidis Park
items.guide: In a roof vent shaft. Fly a drone up, then drop a Spiderbot into the shaft.

items.name: Southwark Incinerator
items.guide: On the rooftop, next to the silos. Use a drone.

items.name: Southwark Auto Conversions
items.guide: On the roof. Use a drone.

items.name: Around LDN Bus Depot
items.guide: On the canopy next to the building. Use a drone.

items.name: Southwark Residential
items.guide: In the construction zone, on the tower.

items.name: St. George Church
items.guide: In a vent shaft on the church roof. Unlock the hatch by solving the circuit on the tower, then enter with a Spiderbot.

items.name: Civil Aviation Traffic Office
items.guide: On the rooftop. Use a drone.

items.name: Tidis Advanced Technologies
items.guide: On the platform next to the building. Reach it by drone, or from inside the building by going to the top and using the movable fan.

items.name: City Hall
items.guide: In a locked room inside the building. Open it from the inside with a Spiderbot.

items.name: King's Head Yard
items.guide: On the pipes on the roof. Use a drone.

items.name: Guy's Hospital
items.guide: On the roof. Use a drone.

items.name: Nexus Tower
items.guide: Inside the complex, at the very top. Place a Spiderbot on the upper shelf and send it into the vent shaft.

items.name: The Mix
items.guide: In a roof vent shaft.

relics.description: Historical or pop-culture artifacts hidden around the city. Collecting 15 unlocks the 'Magpie' trophy/achievement. Many are also tied to story progress.

items.name: 17th Century Medical Saw (fragment)
items.guide: On a shelf directly from the main entrance. Sneak in through the open balcony at the side entrance, or fly a cargo drone in (gets you detected).

items.name: Egyptian Artifact
items.guide: In a warehouse on the terminal's lower level. Take the key from the guard patrolling the upper level, then download it using surveillance cameras.

items.name: Scooter Headlamp (fragment)
items.guide: In a guarded part of the market, in the medical room near the storage room, on a shelf against the wall. Use a Spiderbot.

items.name: Bartmann Jug (fragment)
items.guide: Go to the penultimate construction level and use the lifter to reach a small shelf. A Spiderbot is the safest way to get it.

items.name: 17th Century Medical Saw (fragment, 2nd)
items.guide: Use the air duct in the side corridor (guard patrols it) and send the Spiderbot in to a small storage room.

items.name: Prototype (Optik 0.1) (fragment)
items.guide: Behind a locked door. Move the parked vehicles, then set the nodes so the blue line connects to the node behind the gate to open the lock.

items.name: 1984 (fragment)
items.guide: Under a bench in the central gardens. Use a cargo drone to reach it.

items.name: 17th-Century Medical Saw (fragment)
items.guide: On scaffolding in a restricted area of the park. Reach it by drone and drop a spiderbot onto the relic.

items.name: Masquerade Ball Prop (fragment)
items.guide: On the building's roof. Use the cargo drone to reach it.

items.name: Scooter Headlamp (fragment)
items.guide: In a container in the central part of the building. Only a spiderbot can access the container.

items.name: Mobile Phone (fragment)
items.guide: On a fenced balcony of a small building next to the structure.

items.name: DedSec Bracelet (fragment)
items.guide: On the building's roof. Fly there with a drone.

items.name: Radio Londres Microphone (fragment)
items.guide: In the tower, under the floor. Deploy a spiderbot and enter the hole in the corner.

items.name: Bartmann Jug (fragment)
items.guide: In a closed tunnel. Deploy a spiderbot, climb the side shelf, and double-jump to reach it.

items.name: 1984 (fragment)
items.guide: Reach the complex gardens and enter the ventilation shaft. It leads to a locked room with another vent — follow it to the relic.

items.name: Platform Shoe (fragment)
items.guide: In a locked room on the building's roof. Access the nearby terminal to unlock the room.

items.name: British Abolition Medallion (fragment)
items.guide: Underneath the renovated bridge support. Deploy a spiderbot at the top of the scaffolding.

items.name: Bartmann Jug (fragment, 2nd)
items.guide: On the outside of the railway bridge. Walk there and jump the fence, or use a drone.

items.name: Platform Shoe (fragment)
items.guide: Use the cargo drone to reach the building's roof, then jump up and collect the relic.

items.name: Scooter Headlamp (fragment)
items.guide: Use the cargo drone to reach the roof.

items.name: Radio Londres Microphone (fragment)
items.guide: Use the cargo drone to reach the roof, then jump up and collect the relic.

items.name: Bartmann Jug (fragment)
items.guide: Guarded restricted area. Enter the small building to the right of the entrance, throw a Spiderbot through the hole at the top, collect the relic, then leave the restricted area.

items.name: Relic
items.guide: On the roof above the main entrance, hidden behind the sign. Reach it with a drone or by using a lift at the building's corner.

items.name: Platform Shoe (fragment)
items.guide: Under the bridge, beside one of the supporting columns.

items.name: Mobile Phone (fragment)
items.guide: Under the bridge, next to a closed room with Tech Points. Requires the spiderbot.

items.name: Floppy Disk
items.guide: In a safe house you unlock right after the prologue.

items.name: Relic
items.guide: In the bushes by one of the facility's gates.

items.name: DedSec Bracelet (fragment)
items.guide: On the roof, under the surface. Use the spiderbot to enter a nearby ventilation shaft.

items.name: Relic
items.guide: On the roof. Fly a drone there.

items.name: Fake DedSec Business Card
items.guide: In a side street, in a fence with banners. Jump over the fence to find it (restricted area).

items.name: Relic
items.guide: On the roof of a small outhouse. Fly a drone up and drop the spiderbot (restricted area).

items.name: Relic
items.guide: Behind the cottage, past a barbed-wire fence. Use a drone or the spiderbot.

items.name: DedSec Bracelet (fragment)
items.guide: On the first floor, inside a closed room. You need the spiderbot, and the ventilation shaft has traps.

items.name: Prototype (Optik 0.1) (fragment)
items.guide: Beneath the stage. You need the spiderbot to reach it.

items.name: TOAN Conference Pass
items.guide: Deploy the spiderbot, go through the hole to the underground car park, and break through a hole in its southern wall. The pass is in the room beyond.

items.name: Mobile Phone (fragment)
items.guide: Inside the hedges around an oval structure in the park. Reaching it requires the spiderbot.

items.name: Mobile Phone (fragment, 2nd)
items.guide: In a rooftop room. Find a hole in the floor and use the spiderbot to get through.

items.name: DedSec Bracelet (fragment, 2nd)
items.guide: On scaffolding under the overpass. Deploy the spiderbot to reach it.

items.name: Prototype (Optik 0.1) (fragment)
items.guide: Under the stairs. Hack the forklift to break the wall.

items.name: Bartmann Jug (fragment)
items.guide: On the roof of the complex.

items.name: Masquerade Ball Prop (fragment)
items.guide: On the rooftop.

items.name: Scooter Headlamp (fragment)
items.guide: In the alcove between the front and main part of the building. Reach it with a drone.

items.name: Radio Londres Microphone (fragment)
items.guide: On the roof, next to the drone summoning point.

items.name: Cocaine Vial
items.guide: Heavily guarded area — hide your character and switch to a spiderbot. Move forward along the left side; behind one of the objects is a ventilation duct. Open the vent and crawl to the end, where a suitcase holds the vial.

items.name: Masquerade Ball Prop (fragment)
items.guide: On the rooftop. Reach it by drone.

items.name: 17th Century Medical Saw (fragment)
items.guide: In the courtyard. A hole in the wall lets you bring in the Spiderbot to collect it.

items.name: 1984 (fragment)
items.guide: In a locked room on the upper floor. Get the key from the adjoining room.

items.name: Masquerade Ball Prop (fragment, 2nd)
items.guide: In the bushes right by the river.

items.name: Radio Londres Microphone (fragment)
items.guide: On the roof. Reach it by drone.

mask_boxes.description: Found in small blue mask boxes scattered across London; wearing masks is cosmetic. 33 of the 38 total have confirmed named locations below; the remaining 5 are unnamed/undetailed in available guides.

items.name: Albion Internment Centre
items.guide: In the control room.

items.name: St. Pancras International
items.guide: On a computer desk.

items.name: Camden Market
items.guide: On the roof.

items.name: DedSec Safehouse
items.guide: On the staircase leading to the first floor.

items.name: Downing Street
items.guide: On top of a crate.

items.name: Broco Tech
items.guide: Next to a pile of barrels.

items.name: Buckingham Palace Gardens
items.guide: At the entrance.

items.name: London Carriage Service
items.guide: On a computer desk.

items.name: New Scotland Yard
items.guide: On a side table beside a computer desk.

items.name: Somerset House
items.guide: On a wooden table.

items.name: Thorne's Felts
items.guide: On a wooden table, reached through the pipeline.

tech_upgrades.description: Spend Tech Points in the Tech menu to unlock all Gadgets, Upgrades, Weapons, and Hacks. Required for the Fully Kitted trophy.
priority_order: Spiderbot Level 2 (Infiltrator or Combat) — the single most useful early upgrade; lets your drone fight back or dive into vents solo.
Deep Profiler — tags every nearby NPC's items/skills through walls, which makes recruiting and casing targets much faster.
AR Shroud — hides your wanted/suspicious icon from casual NPCs so you can move around hot zones without being reported.
Gun Jam — remotely jams an enemy's weapon; great panic button against guards and snipers.
Chase Drone Hacks (all 3 tiers) and Turret Hacks (all 3 tiers) — turn the game's own pursuit drones and turrets into tools that fight for you instead of against you.

The three Deactivation upgrades (Chase Drone, Turret, Combat Drone) only unlock once you've turned boroughs Defiant (2 / 4 / 6 boroughs) — Chase Drone Deactivation also costs 10 TP once unlocked, the other two are free once unlocked.

All three DedSec weapon upgrades (MP9 SMG, LTL SG, DedSec Grenade Launcher) are locked behind turning just 1 borough Defiant — only the starting LTL 68P Pistol is available with no Defiance requirement.

build_guides.name: Stealth / Infiltrator build
build_guides.focus: Ghost through missions without raising alarms.
build_guides.note: AR Cloak breaks line-of-sight detection, Attract and Disrupt Hacks pull/distract guards away from your path, and the Electro-Shock Trap handles anyone who finds you anyway.

build_guides.name: Aggressive / Combat build
build_guides.focus: Fight through resistance instead of avoiding it.
build_guides.note: Combat Spiderbot and Missile Drone give you ranged firepower that doesn't cost you health, and Gun Jam plus the Grenade Launcher clear out armored or grouped enemies fast.

build_guides.name: Hacker / Drone-control build
build_guides.focus: Turn the city's own security against itself.
build_guides.note: Once hacked, these let you ride or command drones/turrets that were previously chasing you — strongest once you've unlocked several hack tiers.

items.name: Infiltrator Spiderbot
items.guide: Stealth-focused Spiderbot: non-lethal takedowns, double jump/sprint and a manual cloak at higher levels.

items.name: AR Cloak
items.guide: Projects a short-range visual camouflage field that hides you from nearby guards.

items.name: Electro-Fist
items.guide: A melee shock weapon built into the glove for fast non-lethal takedowns.

items.name: Electro-Shock Trap
items.guide: A throwable trap that stuns anyone who walks through it.

items.name: Combat Spiderbot
items.guide: A more aggressive Spiderbot variant that can fight back in combat.

items.name: Missile Drone
items.guide: A cargo drone upgrade that can fire a guided missile.

items.name: AR Shroud
items.guide: Lets you hide the bodies of anyone you've taken down in plain sight.

items.name: Skin Mesh
items.guide: Reduces incoming damage taken by all DedSec operatives.

items.name: Deep Profiler
items.guide: Reveals schedule and contact info for recruits who have a negative opinion of DedSec, letting you recruit them anyway.

items.name: Chase Drone Deactivation
items.guide: Permanently disables nearby chase drones.
items.unlock_requirement: Unlock: turn 2 boroughs Defiant (removes DedSec Chase Drones from that borough once done citywide)

items.name: Turret Deactivation
items.guide: Permanently disables nearby turrets. Unlocks after a borough turns Defiant (no Tech Point cost).
items.unlock_requirement: Unlock: turn 4 boroughs Defiant (disables hostile turrets in cleared boroughs)

items.name: Combat Drone Deactivation
items.guide: Permanently disables nearby combat drones. Unlocks after a borough turns Defiant (no Tech Point cost).
items.unlock_requirement: Unlock: turn 6 boroughs Defiant (disables Combat Drones in cleared boroughs)

items.name: LTL 68P DedSec Pistol
items.guide: Non-lethal silenced sidearm, available from the start (no Tech Point cost).

items.name: MP9 DedSec SMG
items.guide: Non-lethal SMG unlocked with Tech Points.

items.name: LTL SG
items.guide: Non-lethal shotgun unlocked with Tech Points.

items.name: DedSec Grenade Launcher
items.guide: Launcher firing non-lethal grenade rounds.

items.name: Disrupt Hack
items.guide: Temporarily disrupts an enemy's balance/aim at range.

items.name: Attract Hack
items.guide: Makes a device or object emit noise to lure guards.

items.name: Chase Drone Hacks
items.guide: Hijack/disable chase drones. 3 tiers: 10 / 15 / 25 Tech Points.

items.name: Gun Jam
items.guide: Jams an enemy's weapon at range.

items.name: Turret Hacks
items.guide: Hijack/disable turrets. 3 tiers: 25 / 30 / 40 Tech Points.

items.name: Parcel Fox Drone Hacks
items.guide: Hijack/disable Parcel Fox delivery drones.

items.name: CT Drone Hacks
items.guide: Hijack/disable Counter-Terrorism drones. 3 tiers: 40 / 45 / 60 Tech Points.

items.name: Riot Drone Hacks
items.guide: Hijack/disable Riot drones. 3 tiers: 20 / 30 / 45 Tech Points.

tips: Liberate boroughs first — completing borough uprisings reveals tech points and key activities directly on the map, making them much easier to track down.
Use an operative with a Cargo Drone (or Wrench) for tech points and text files on high rooftops or hard-to-reach ledges — saves a lot of time versus climbing.
Community interactive maps (MapGenie's Watch Dogs Legion map, Guides for Gamers' Watch Dogs Legion interactive maps) can be used alongside this tracker to visually cross-check progress.
